title: A Rooster Among Cranes
overview: Keiji, the wandering rooster, lands in a new city, but a Demon suddenly appears!

title: The Caged Bird
overview: Keiji's injured soon after he saves Piyoko's "Pops" from permanently transforming into a Demon.

title: The Parable of the Three Birds
overview: Elizabeth challenges Keiji to a fight and divulges info about the White Demon, his sworn enemy.

title: Homing in on Desire
overview: The trio find themselves at a village where the adults have been brainwashed by a Demon.

title: The Motley Flock Scatters
overview: The trio have a falling out and go their separate ways, while a typhoon ominously approaches.

title: Built Like a Brick Coop
overview: When Morio's efforts fail, the flood approaches! Will Keiji and his flock be able to save the city?

title: Crowing Over a Feather
overview: Keiji puts his chicken pride on the line and accepts an invitation to a group date!

title: Not All Feathers Hold a Song
overview: Keiji finds out a brainwashed Morio is on a rampage and heads out to save him.

title: Gone to the Birds
overview: Demons and Devils lie in wait to attack Keiji and his flock.

title: To Back a Bird into a Corner
overview: Keiji and his friends struggle against the powerful Devil, Yuji.

title: It Takes Two Wings to Fly
overview: Keisuke's new power awakens when he witnesses Keiji's struggle against Hikari.

title: What the Birds, Beasts, and Trees Share
overview: Keiji overwhelms Hikari with his new power, the Awakening of Ruin.
